description:
The cross-database portability recall fixture, and the only place any `DJX` rule has a known answer. Measuring this family on the benchmark corpus is not merely inconvenient, it is impossible: every `DJX` rule is gated on `Divergence.reaches`, which requires evidence that the project runs two engines, and of the three benchmark projects only Healthchecks passes that gate -- NetBox and pretix both compute their `ENGINE` at import time and cannot be read statically at all. Healthchecks then turns out to contain almost none of the constructs this family is about: zero `JSONField`, zero `ArrayField`, zero `icontains`, zero `Trunc`, and two `.distinct()` calls that are both the portable no-argument form. So the corpus can measure this family's precision and cannot measure its recall even in principle, which is why the recall evidence has to be built here.

`config/settings.py` carries the divergence and is what makes every other file in this project reportable: SQLite unconditionally, Postgres behind `DB=postgres`, which is the shape Healthchecks uses. Deleting that `if` should silence the entire family here, and that is worth more than any single pair -- it is the difference between a portability rule and a style rule.

`catalog` holds the defects and `warehouse` holds their correctly-written twins. Each pair differs only in the thing its rule is about. `latest_per_supplier` uses `distinct('sku')` and its twin expresses the same per-group-latest question with a subquery, rather than asking a weaker question -- a control that simply dropped the requirement would not be the same query and would not show that the requirement can be met portably. `warehouse` is not a general improvement on `catalog` anywhere: it keeps the same columns, the same unique constraint and the same `JSONField`, because a control that fixed two things at once would leave one rule's claim untested.

`DJX-001` and `DJX-009` are the two rules here with no twin in `warehouse`, because both are reported once for the whole project rather than once per site. `DJX-009` counts every column whose declared width or range SQLite ignores, and `warehouse` cannot be the portable half of that -- its `CharField`s are as unenforced as `catalog`'s, which is the finding's whole point. Their control is the settings file: removing the `if` that introduces the second engine silences them along with the rest of the family.
